name_reason: Name accurately reflects purpose and logic. All numeric suffixes are domain-meaningful or reference an established symbol, with NO address residue: id_27 = decimal of spell_id 0x1B (麻痹術/paralysis, a valid FD2 spell ID, verified via fd2-knowledge); effect_26 = effect/sprite id literal 0x26 pushed to the worker; via_status_d1b references the existing worker symbol fd2_cast_status_spell_via_d1b (the d1b fragment is part of that worker's own name, not this function's address 0x22e41 nor any data address). Prefix fd2_ correct for game function. The id_<decimal> style matches the sibling fd2_spell_handler_id_26_via_status_d1b_effect_25 (0x1A), so keeping is internally consistent within the d1b sub-family (decimal-vs-hex stylistic alignment with the 0x16 dispatch_cda entry would be only a marginal change, not required).
stage2_review: FAMILY OVERRIDE keep->rename fd2_cast_spell_1b_dispatch. The spell_handler_id_27_via_status_d1b_effect_26 name is inconsistent with its dispatch-table siblings 0x14-0x1a (all unified to fd2_cast_spell_NN_dispatch); aligned. Decimal id_27 -> hex 1b; via_status_d1b/effect_26 dropped (worker identity carried by the worker name).
purpose: Thin spell dispatch-table handler for spell_id 0x1B (麻痹術, paralysis): forwards to the shared status-inflict worker fd2_cast_status_spell_via_d1b with effect/sprite id 0x26.
logic_summary: Single call: fd2_cast_status_spell_via_d1b(caster, 0x1b, n_tgt, tgt_arr, 0x26). In the original binary this is a tail-jump sibling: after its own __CHK(0x18) prologue and pushing effect_id 0x26, target_id_array, n_targets and spell_id 0x1B, it JMP 0x22BF7 into the 0x16 dispatch body (fd2_cast_spell_16_dispatch_cda @ 0x22BE1) to reuse the {push caster + CALL worker @ 0x22CDA + ADD ESP,0x14 + RET} shared tail. Registered in the spell dispatch table @ 0x51D01 at entry index 0x1B (slot @ 0x51D6D, verified: read_memory(0x51D6D)=0x00022e41).
signature: void __cdecl fd2_spell_handler_id_27_via_status_d1b_effect_26(int caster, int n_tgt, int tgt_arr)

params.name: caster
params.semantics: Caster unit id, passed through unchanged to the worker (worker arg caster_idx).
params.reason: Descriptive, matches the sibling/family convention in spell.c, no address residue.

params.name: n_tgt
params.semantics: Number of targets, passed through to the worker.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches family convention, no address residue.

params.name: tgt_arr
params.semantics: Pointer to the target-id array (carried as int), passed through to the worker. The 0x1A/0x1B d1b pair use int (not uint8*) matching the decompiled int target_id_array.
params.reason: Descriptive abbreviation of target array, matches the 0x1A sibling's signature, no address residue.

comment_original_issue: The 0x1B handler had NO dedicated comment block of its own -- it sat bare immediately after the 0x1A handler, with only a forward-reference in the 0x1A comment ('Sibling: the 0x1B entry below'). Missing its own spell name (麻痹術/paralysis), dispatch-table entry address (0x22E41), table slot (table[0x1B] @ 0x51D6D), effect id (0x26), and shared-tail note.
notes: Verified spell_id 0x1B = 麻痹術 (paralysis), 輔助法術, via fd2-knowledge. Dispatch table entry math: 0x51D01 + 0x1B*4 = 0x51D6D; read_memory(0x51D6D) little-endian = 0x00022e41 (this handler). Worker fd2_cast_status_spell_via_d1b @ 0x22cda confirmed (body 0x22cda-0x22d1a); _d1b in worker name is not its own address. Ghidra plate already accurate and detailed (matches refined understanding), left unchanged per src-as-source-of-truth/consistency rule. Sibling 0x1A handler (fd2_spell_handler_id_26_via_status_d1b_effect_25 @ 0x22cbf) uses identical id_<decimal>/via_status_d1b/effect_<hex> naming. No logic changed.
